title: Batch observation path discards the synchronous-save error of later per-row delta commits without logging or marking it
outcome: Batch observation path discards the synchronous-save error of later per-row delta commits without logging or marking it
acceptance: In persist_test_run_evidence_batch_with_compaction_locked, an Err from a later row's commit_delta_locked (stopped-worker synchronous save failure) is logged or recorded (e.g. that row marked failed or a dirty-retry marker), instead of a bare discard; revision allocation and publication stay as w-cee5 left them.

A regression shows the case where the first save succeeds and a later per-row save fails is visible to the operator; the review pair finds no Medium or higher and the full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
